notes: Keys are Greek OSM names (match ROADS by name). Coordinates: game metres, x=(lon-23.8125)*87716, z=-(lat-38.0727)*110998. researched=false entries are derived from OSM tags/map geometry only. styles{} is the catalogue of real local street-furniture designs referenced by lamps.style, bollards.style, sidewalk.materialDetail, etc. Confidence: photo | official | description | inferred.

kifisia_globe.desc: Cast-iron pedestrian post: stepped round plinth, bulbous fluted base to 0.9 m, slim fluted shaft, collar, one opal-white sphere on top. Stands in the sidewalk 0.5 m behind the kerb.

kifisia_lantern.desc: Cast-iron traditional post: square-to-round fluted base 0.9 m with a spiral garland relief winding up the lower shaft, slim shaft, four-sided tapering glass lantern with a small roof and finial.

kifisia_double_globe.desc: Dark-green cast-iron post ~4 m with a decorative scroll cross-arm carrying TWO opal-white spheres (one each side, slightly above the arm) and a small finial between them.

kifisia_lantern_double.desc: Same post as kifisia_lantern with a short cross-arm carrying two lanterns (seen where the sidewalk is wide, north side of Kolokotroni).

globe_cluster.desc: Black/dark-green slim post with 2 or 3 opal globes on short curved arms (park and courtyard lamp).
seen: Kefalari grove: 3 globes on curved swan-neck arms + 1 on top (r04)

avenue_mast.desc: Tall galvanised steel road-lighting column with a single or double curved arm and LED/sodium luminaire, in the median or at the kerb of Kifisias Avenue.
seen: Kifisias Avenue (OSM lit=yes; typical Attica avenue column)

pole_arm.desc: Residential streets: no decorative posts. A luminaire on a 1.2 m galvanised arm bolted at ~7 m to the concrete (or tarred wooden) electricity pole; overhead cables run pole to pole along one side of the street.
seen: utility poles with overhead lines on Kassaveti east (r16) and Levidou (r19)

ball_green.desc: Slim round steel post with a collar and a ball finial; set 0.3 m behind the kerb on BOTH sidewalks to stop pavement parking.

baluster_green_yellow.desc: Cast-iron baluster bollard: round flared foot, slim tapering body, one yellow band ~0.12 m below the top, acorn/ball finial; very dark green (reads black at night). Stands at the kerb edge of the shop sidewalk.
seen: Kassaveti north side in front of Mythos Plus (mythos01)

cone_black_gold.desc: Short cast-iron baluster bollard: flared round foot, tapering body, neck ring painted gold/yellow, rounded cap. Lines the edge between the cycle track and the carriageway.

cyl_black_yellow.desc: Plain black steel cylinder with a ribbed top section and one yellow reflective band 0.12 m high about 0.15 m below the top. Dense rows on both sides of the paved lane.

red_tile.desc: Terracotta-red square cement tiles ~0.3 x 0.3 m laid in a straight grid with fine joints, in panels separated by bands of the same tile; tree pits are plain earth squares ~1.2 m edged with a flat concrete band. A yellow ribbed tactile strip 0.4 m wide runs along the middle of the sidewalk.

buff_pavers.desc: Small rectangular concrete block pavers ~0.1 x 0.2 m, grey-buff with a pink cast, laid stretcher/herringbone; flush cast-iron service covers.

redbrown_block_road.desc: CARRIAGEWAY surface (not sidewalk): rectangular concrete block pavers ~0.1 x 0.2 m in red-brown/mauve tones, stretcher bond across the street, with a 0.3 m band of pale concrete blocks along each edge; yellow zig-zag / box markings painted on the blocks at stops and entrances.

grey_block_road.desc: CARRIAGEWAY of pale grey concrete block pavers ~0.1 x 0.2 m in stretcher bond, flush with the side walkways (no raised kerb; bollards do the separating).
seen: Levidou, block between Kassaveti and Kolokotroni, 2015 (r19)

cycle_asphalt.desc: Cycle track: smooth dark-grey fine asphalt/screed strip, level with the sidewalk and 2-3 cm above the block carriageway, edged on the road side by a 0.25 m white concrete band.

marble_slabs.desc: White-grey Pentelic-type marble slabs in mixed rectangles (0.3-0.6 m) laid in bands, with small red clay insets at joints.
seen: garden path of the neoclassical house Kifisias 297 (r08)

cement_slabs.desc: Standard Greek municipal sidewalk: grey pressed-cement slabs 0.4 x 0.4 m (often with a 4x4 grooved pattern), patched with poured concrete at driveways.
seen: typical for residential Kifisia; not photographed street by street

asphalt_worn.desc: Sun-bleached asphalt with darker trench patches and round/rectangular cast-iron covers (r16, r21).

kerb.desc: Kerbs are pale precast concrete / white-grey marble-chip blocks 0.15 m wide with a 0.12-0.15 m upstand; at Platanos square the kerb face is painted yellow (no stopping).

green_x_guard.desc: Pedestrian guard-rail panels along the kerb: dark-green square-tube frame 1.0 m high x 2.0 m long, infill of two crossing diagonals with a small diamond at the centre; posts every 2 m.

green_lattice_low.desc: Low ornamental railing around planted verges: dark-green posts with pointed caps every 2 m, lattice/diamond mesh panel 0.8 m high.

garden_green_bars.desc: Property boundary: 0.6-1.0 m plastered or rubble-stone plinth wall with square stone/plaster piers every 3-4 m and 1.0-1.2 m of vertical bar railing between them, usually dark green, backed by a clipped hedge or ivy.

garden_white_bars.desc: White vertical-bar railing 1.0 m high on a low beige plastered wall.

rubble_wall.desc: Dry-look rubble limestone garden wall 0.9-1.2 m high in pale grey-white stone, hedge above.

wheeled_1100.desc: Municipal 1100-litre four-wheel container, dark grey-green body with a curved lid, usually standing in the carriageway against the kerb; often with graffiti tags.

litter_post.desc: Small dark-green litter basket on a post near crossings.
seen: Platanos (r11, black bin at the corner)

street_plate.desc: Greek street-name plate: blue enamel rectangle ~0.6 x 0.2 m with white capitals, Greek on top and Latin transliteration below, fixed on the corner building or wall at 2.5-3 m.

taxi.desc: Athens taxis are yellow saloons (Skoda Octavia / Mercedes E / Toyota) with a roof TAXI light.

streets.character: Kifisia's best-known cafe and shopping street. It starts at Platanos square on Kifisias Avenue and climbs gently east (2.7 %) for 440 m. The first 160 m (to the junction with Levidou, Kyriazi and Agiou Dimitriou - the player's spawn) are lined shop-to-shop with cafes, fast food and boutiques under big plane trees; east of the junction it turns residential within one block: garden walls, railings, hedges and villas behind them.

WEST BLOCK (looking east, the direction of traffic): north facades | private forecourt with cafe terraces ~4.4 m | sidewalk ~2.6 m | kerb | 6.0 m asphalt, two lanes one-way (left lane used by the taxi queue / stopping, right lane running) | 2.4 m two-way cycle track | sidewalk ~4.0 m | south facades.  Total facade to facade 19-21.5 m (measured from OSM building outlines).
EAST END (photo r16, x~300): garden wall + green railing | 3.0 m buff-paver sidewalk with plane trees in 1.5 m earth pits and ball-top bollards every 2.4 m | pale kerb 0.15 m | 3.8 m asphalt single lane, no markings | kerb | 3.0 m buff-paver sidewalk with ball-top bollards and globe lamp posts | low beige wall + white railing.

segments.sidewalkMaterialDetail: red_tile: glossy terracotta squares ~0.35 m in a straight grid with darker bands (photo mythos01, north side)

segments.terraces: cafe terraces on the north forecourt enclosed by low black steel frames (~1 m) with glass/plants, black fabric awnings over the shopfronts, patio heaters (photo mythos01)
segments.trees: old plane trees planted in the north sidewalk at the kerb (pale mottled trunk left of Mythos, photo)
segments.overhead: cables strung between facades and a utility pole (photo)
segments.note: Shop block. North side W->E: Varsos, Holland & Barrett, Nova, Ancho, To Kalamaki..., Veneti bakery, Mythos Plus, Goody's, Everest (corner of Levidou). South side: Dust Cream, Vodafone, AB Vasilopoulos (corner of Kyriazi). Cafe tables stand on the north forecourts, not on the public sidewalk. Mapped zebra crossings at both ends. Widths are derived from OSM sidewalk centre-lines and building outlines, not from a survey.

Transition block: Kifisia Tower / La Pasteria on the south corner, Carpo, Desigual, Germanos and the open-air cinema Chloe (north side, x~150), then boutiques in converted villas (Different Beast, Kassaveti Tower). Street narrows to one lane; bollards and globe lamps start.

Exactly as in photo r16 (camera at x=303, z=134 looking east): single unmarked asphalt lane between two paved sidewalks, ball-top bollards on both kerbs, old plane trees on the north sidewalk whose trunks lean over the road, globe lamp posts on the south sidewalk, an 1100 L wheeled bin standing on the sidewalk build-out, garden walls with stone piers and green railings (north) and a beige wall with white railing (south). Ends at Georganta / G. Karaiskaki.

streets.character: Kifisias Avenue (national road EO83) is the spine of the suburb. Coming from Athens it is a dual carriageway - two lanes each way with a narrow median - up to Platanos square, where the two carriageways pass either side of the planted island; north of the square (from about z=-30) it is ONE carriageway with one lane each way plus bus stops, lined with banks, shops and offices, and it leaves the centre past the Othonos and Deligianni junctions. Traffic lights at Kassaveti, Platanos, Panagitsas/Papadiamanti, Othonos and Deligianni.
streets.crossSection:
SOUTH OF PLATANOS (dual): facade | 3-4 m sidewalk | 7.0 m southbound carriageway (2 lanes, white dashed lane line, solid edge lines) | 1.5-2 m raised median with shrubs and mast lights | 7.0 m northbound carriageway (2 lanes) | 3-4 m sidewalk | facade. Facade to facade ~30 m.
NORTH OF PLATANOS (single): facade | 3 m sidewalk | 9-10 m carriageway: one lane each way, double white centre line, bus bays | 3 m sidewalk | facade. Narrowest facade gap 18 m.

segments.note: Northbound carriageway (east one). Passes the Roman monument block and the corner of Kassaveti (x=-68, z=46); zebra + signals there.
Southbound carriageway (west one), along the east edge of the Platanos island and then the Alsos side.

Single carriageway through the northern centre: KFC at Kifisias 238-240 (x=-4, z=-11), National Bank (x=-46, z=-63), Plaisio (x=-44, z=-229), police station nearby on Othonos side. AERIAL r09 (Dec 2022, camera over Platanos looking north up the avenue): old plane trees (bare in winter) on BOTH sidewalks forming a continuous canopy; the National Bank on the WEST side is a modern 3-storey white block with full-height glass curtain-wall bays and a low pyramid skylight roof covered in blue solar panels, set back behind a stepped paved plaza with young palms; on the EAST side low buildings with large red tiled hip roofs and colonnaded cafe terraces (the Mela arcade / KFC block is among them - identified by address, not by the photo); a signalised zebra with a crowd at Platanos, a white kiosk/shelter on the east sidewalk, buses and taxis in the stream; a yellow-painted kerb curve at the square.

streets.character: The elegant shopping street of Kifisia: boutiques in old villas and small arcades (Agora, Aigli, Foinikes, Shoppingland), running 560 m uphill (3 %) from Levidou to Charilaou Trikoupi / Kefalari. Unmistakable surface: the carriageway is paved with red-brown concrete blocks, a grey cycle track runs along its south side behind a line of little black-and-gold bollards, and the south sidewalk is red tile under tall plane trees with spiral-decorated lantern posts.
streets.crossSection: Looking WEST (downhill, as in photos r17 and r18), left to right = south to north: garden wall / shopfront | 3.0 m red-tile sidewalk (plane trees in earth pits and lantern posts stand in its outer 1 m; yellow tactile strip down the middle) | 2.8 m dark-grey cycle track | 0.25 m white concrete band carrying cone bollards every 1.5 m | 3.5 m lane of red-brown blocks (traffic comes towards you: one-way eastbound) | 2.0 m parallel parking on the same blocks, marked by a pale block band; yellow zig-zag where stopping is banned | 0.15 m kerb | 2.5 m sidewalk | rubble-stone garden wall with hedge / shopfront. Facade to facade 22-28 m.

segments.note: OSM tags this way lanes=2: the second "lane" is the parking strip. Shops both sides for the first 250 m (Foinikas arcade at no. 1, x=210 z=-45; Aigli arcades no. 8, x=200-226 z=17-36; Shoppingland x=256 z=-13; Foinikes / Agora complex at no. 7 (x=329 z=-22) with the white turreted folly (Rinaldi in 2015; photos r12 and r06, x~312-345 z~10-16); Marks & Spencer x=339 z=45, GANT). East of x~400 mostly villas (Villa Elli, no. 26, x=493 z=18).
Bends north-east to Charilaou Trikoupi beside the former Palace hotel; no cycle track on this piece in OSM. Double-lantern posts on the north side (photo r17 was taken at x=535, z=-73).

streets.character: Leaves the spawn junction to the north-east. The first 103 m (to the corner of Kolokotroni and Panagitsas) is a quiet, leafy, shared-surface lane: PAUL stands on its east side in a villa set back behind a garden. North of Kolokotroni it passes the Panagitsa chapel area, the Kouvoutsakis gallery (no. 11) and the Goulandris Natural History Museum (no. 13) and continues as a one-lane residential street to Othonos and Deligianni.
streets.crossSection: FIRST BLOCK (photo r19, camera at the Kolokotroni corner looking south-west towards the spawn junction): hedge / garden wall | 2.5-3 m walkway of grey blocks | row of black bollards with a yellow band every 1.25 m | 3.8 m lane of pale grey concrete blocks, no kerb, no markings | row of bollards | parking bay / walkway 2.5 m (cars nose-to-tail beyond the bollards on the north-west side) | hedge. Lantern posts stand in the bollard line on the south-east side. Facade to facade 22-31 m: the buildings sit far back behind gardens.

segments.note: Block between Kassaveti and Kolokotroni; PAUL at x=125.5, z=33 (east side). Photo r19 is from April 2015; the 2021 municipal study planned new surfacing for the cycle track here, so the colour of the lane today may differ.
Kolokotroni to Othonos: Kouvoutsakis gallery (Levidou 11, x=155, z=-131), Goulandris Natural History Museum and Retsina mansion (Levidou 13, x=188, z=-189). Gardens, stone walls, pines.
Othonos to the stream bridge: villas and apartment blocks behind walls (Levidou 26 neoclassical house at x=326, z=-363).
